text: This Year's Sweets Are Safe & Worry-Free
Pelulu has turned into a giant monster!\nFilecia suspects that Lefina's tea is the cause.\nCollect the materials for the medicine to cure Pelulu!
After making the medicine, you and Filecia rush to Pelulu,\nhowever with her current condition, it is impossible to make\nher take the medicine. Let's get her under control!
